rule: Count roman-numeral manufacturer/region families from the COO sheet or figure-guide image. Where the image and the page text disagree, the image wins. A column marked not this figure is not counted. A second factory under the same numeral is not a new family. Paint, cape and sabre sections are not counted. If the images show no readable roman grid, the figure is unverified.
